text: Agentic e-invoicing. AI agents for the French e-invoicing reform, running on Kubernetes.
Here is how it works. The agents never answer from memory. Every fact and every check comes from an MCP tool server: a sourced rule base, an invoice checker, and the public company register.
All of it is declared as Kubernetes resources, and one command brings it up.
Ask a regulation question. The expert cites its rules. Then a reviewer checks every citation, and deletes the sentences the rules don't back.
Now a broken invoice, with a hidden line telling the AI to say it is fine. The checker finds all four errors, verifies the buyer in the public register, and ignores the injection.
And it is not locked to one platform. The same agents, tools and tests run on McKinsey's ARK, and on kagent from the CNCF. All sixteen tests pass on ARK, and all fourteen that apply pass on kagent.
Grounded agents, tested before they ship, on any Kubernetes. The code is on GitHub.
